clips.title: The story
paras: Scourge forces at the Agamand Mills threaten the Forsaken's hold on Tirisfal. From Brill, Magistrate Sevren sends agents against the undead in the family crypt.

The Forsaken hold Tirisfal Glades, but the Scourge still grips much of its countryside. The Agamand Mills once produced flour for Lordaeron; now they are a Scourge stronghold. In Brill, Magistrate Sevren watches the enemy gather with grave concern. Every stretch of land lost to the undead weakens the Forsaken's independence.

Captain Dargol, a skeletal commander, has made the Agamand Family Crypt his headquarters. Through necromancy, he raises generations of the Agamand dead as Rotting and Wailing Ancestors to swell his ranks. Magistrate Sevren sends Forsaken agents to purge the crypt, lay the disturbed dead to rest, and sever Dargol's head to disrupt Scourge forces in northern Tirisfal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge. Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered. With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.
This cannot pass, and you must stop it. Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.
And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Time is not a luxury we have, friend. With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge. And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.
Continue the struggle as we all do, friend, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from Azeroth!
